title: AI for Job Seekers: Improve Your Resume and Interview Practice | Ep 16
description:
AI for Job Seekers: Improve Your Resume and Interview Practice. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 16 of 50

What you will learn: Tailor a resume and practice interviews truthfully.
Example: rewriting a project manager achievement.
Try it: turn one real achievement into a results-focused bullet.
Remember: never invent qualifications or experience.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
